name: USDC (Circle FiatTokenProxy)
not_assessed: the money behind one key (no money figure, or no key count)
the protocol's total value locked (no DefiLlama match)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: The proxy admin, the owner, the blacklister and the pauser are all accounts with no code, and so is the owner of the masterMinter contract. Any of them can upgrade, blacklist, pause or set minters, with no delay.
narrative.tag: accounts with no code, no timelock, composite 2
narrative.detail: Added 2026-10-11. Scored 5 / 0 / 0 (composite 2): the componentwise minimum over five controllers, all read on two independent RPCs the same day. Whether one key, an HSM or an MPC service holds an account with no code cannot be observed on chain; the score treats it as a bare EOA, the methodology's convention. The implementation slot holds 0x4350…02dd, so the logic can be replaced by the proxy admin. This reads who holds the controls, not how they are operated: it is a statement about on-chain authority, not a prediction of loss.

steps.what: owner() on the contract: the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (6 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# owner() on the contract: the holder
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"0xa0b86991c6218b36c1d19d4a2e9eb0ce3606eb48","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"latest"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (6 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 26250101 and 26250103 of the chain; this RPC cannot replay the block of the read (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the answers are the current ones

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 6 transactions sent; delay: none
